product.name: Hellosaurus Interactive Stories
product.description: Interactive stories featuring various characters and themes, designed to engage children through activities like drawing, sorting, and problem-solving.

product.name: Hellosaurus Creator Studio
product.description: A platform that allows users to make any video interactive by adding templates and activities, enabling hands-on engagement through multi-touch, camera, microphone, and motion sensors.

product.name: Bounce Patrol Interactive Stories
product.description: Interactive stories with catchy songs and nursery rhymes to teach children colors, numbers, alphabet, and animals.

product.name: KIDZ BOP Interactive Stories
product.description: Interactive stories where children can tap along to popular songs from the KIDZ BOP music brand.

product.name: Super Simple Interactive Stories
product.description: Interactive stories that teach children through songs, activities, and play, featuring characters like Caitie.

product.name: MarMar Land Interactive Stories
product.description: Interactive stories set in MarMar Land, focusing on adventure and learning with elements like slime, music, and baby dragons.
